decision.sql:
WITH years AS (
    SELECT generate_series(2000, 2020) AS order_year
),
backorder_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orderdate)::int AS order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS customers_with_backorders
    FROM sales.orders
    WHERE isundersupplybackordered = true
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orderdate) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orderdate)
)
SELECT 
    y.order_year,
    COALESCE(b.customers_with_backorders, 0) AS customers_with_backorders
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN backorder_customers b ON y.order_year = b.order_year
ORDER BY y.order_year

decision.sql:
SELECT c.cityname, COUNT(s.supplierid) AS supplier_count
FROM purchasing.suppliers s
JOIN application.cities c ON s.deliverycityid = c.cityid
GROUP BY c.cityname
ORDER BY supplier_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    c.cityname,
    c.latestrecordedpopulation,
    COUNT(s.supplierid) AS supplier_count,
    CAST(c.latestrecordedpopulation AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(s.supplierid), 0) AS population_per_supplier_ratio
FROM application.cities c
LEFT JOIN purchasing.suppliers s ON s.deliverycityid = c.cityid
WHERE c.latestrecordedpopulation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.cityid, c.cityname, c.latestrecordedpopulation
HAVING COUNT(s.supplierid) > 0
ORDER BY population_per_supplier_ratio DESC
LIMIT 5
